Application Data.NAME: Grace Community Church
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Facility Manager, Grace Community Church, (555) 123-4567
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Grace Community Church provides a welcoming space for worship, community outreach, and educational programs. Our operations include regular Sunday services, youth groups, and community events such as holiday celebrations and charity drives. Additionally, we offer limited food service during gatherings, adhering to local health and safety regulations. Our church is committed to fostering a safe environment, prioritizing the well-being of our congregation and visitors. We utilize a volunteer workforce to support our activities, emphasizing training and oversight to manage risks associated with our operations. We do not engage in childcare services on the premises, and any events involving food or alcohol are carefully monitored and comply with necessary permits and insurance requirements.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, during a community event, a slip-and-fall incident occurred resulting in injuries to a participant. The total estimated loss was $3,500, which is currently being handled by our insurance provider and is in an open status. Additionally, on July 15, 2022, a minor theft incident occurred where equipment valued at $1,500 was stolen from the church premises. This claim has been resolved and the status is closed.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel present during events and installation of perimeter fencing for safety.
